data.name: proFagus
data.description: proFagus GmbH is a German charcoal maker in Bodenfelde, Lower Saxony, producing charcoal there since 1896. It is a market leader in beech barbecue charcoal and briquettes and also makes natural additive and smoke-flavour products. It is owned by the investor Borromin Capital and has about 150 employees. Searches found no public evidence of certified biochar carbon-sink or CDR credit activity.
